curtailment.basis: industry-claimed 10-15% daytime curtailment for ground solar (owner's Nov 2026 research doc); midpoint; scenario only

limitations: Placeholder site (PR 1) and placeholder O&M, financing and grid inputs.
Ordinary-suite tests exercise reduced grids only; this run is not tail-adequacy, convergence, lender or bankability evidence (TEST-03).
BESS priced per kWh on a 4 h basis at every duration.
The 10 MW limit's reading, and whether the turbine on the same lot counts against it, are open legal questions; both readings are reported.
The BESS container footprint is a 6 h product's (power-bound at 4 h), so the land maximum is conservative for large batteries.
spec.summary: concise: one grid row per point; the full point only for the named sizes

statistics_convention: p50 median; p90 exceeded in 90% of trials (10th percentile); p10 exceeded in 10% (90th percentile)
